desc: Parse H, W and the grid; convert each row into an integer bitmask.
Build a frequency array `cnt` of size `1 << W` for row masks.
Build the kernel array `f[X] = min(popcount(X), W - popcount(X))` for all `X`.
Apply Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform to both `cnt` and `f`.
Multiply the two transformed arrays elementwise.
Apply inverse FWHT and divide by `1 << W` to obtain the convolution results.
The answer is the minimum value in the resulting array.
